🫏 New post ready 📚 List · school days · 8 slides “how brave we used to be between nine and three” 📝 Slides
1. how brave we used to be between nine and three 2. raising your hand straight in the air before you even had the rest of the sentence ready. 3. standing up in front of thirty desks to read three shaky lines you wrote about a stray dog. 4. walking straight up to the big wooden desk just to say "i don't get it". 5. leaving a grey pebble from the gravel yard on the corner of the chalk tray, certain it was safe. 6. crying over a torn workbook page by the metal pencil sharpener, without once hiding your face. 7. handing over a lopsided picture of your family, never doubting it belonged taped flat to the blackboard. 8. save this for a morning you hesitate, and remember the teacher who gave you that nerve.
✍️ Caption
nobody is born second-guessing what they have to say. we only felt that brave because one good teacher made thirty desks feel safe. save this for a morning you hesitate before speaking up. #childhoodmemories #schoolmemories #elementaryschool #growingup
